Audit model selection across held-out datasets

Source: R/lodo-engine-audit.R
lodo_engine_audit.Rd

Score each tidyAML regression or classification specification on a shared testing split within each dataset. Hold out one dataset at a time, select the model with the lowest mean loss on the other datasets, and compare its mean selection loss to its loss on the held-out dataset. Models are fitted within each dataset; this audits the choice of model specification, not transfer of fitted weights across datasets.

Usage

lodo_engine_audit(
  .datasets_list,
  .outcome_var,
  .parsnip_eng = NULL,
  .parsnip_fns = "all",
  .metric = "rmse",
  .event_level = "first",
  .split_args = NULL,
  .seed = NULL
)

Arguments

.datasets_list

Named list of at least two data frames. Each must contain .outcome_var; other column names may differ across datasets.

.outcome_var

Name of one outcome column common to all datasets.

.parsnip_eng

Character vector of engines to compare. With NULL, use c("lm", "ranger") for regression or "glm" for classification. Pass more than one working specification to audit a selection decision.

.parsnip_fns

Character vector of model families to include, or "all" for all supported families for the requested engines.

.metric

"rmse" for a numeric outcome; "roc_auc" (as 1 - AUC) or "mn_log_loss" for a factor outcome. Loss is always smaller-is-better.

.event_level

"first" or "second", used for binary probability metrics. Multiclass metrics use all class probabilities in factor order.

.split_args

Optional arguments for rsample::initial_split(), applied to the shared split within each dataset.

.seed

Optional integer seed for splitting and fitting. A supplied seed leaves the caller's R RNG state unchanged.

Value

A tibble with one row per held-out dataset and columns held_out_dataset, selected_model, selection_loss, held_out_loss, and generalization_gap (held_out_loss - selection_loss). The .lodo_scores attribute is a tibble with dataset, model, loss, and error columns; .lodo_metric records the requested metric.

Details

Only models scored on every selection dataset are eligible. Exact ties are broken by model label in bytewise order. A failed score on the held-out dataset does not change selection: the held-out loss and gap are NA. Folds with no eligible model have NA for all result fields except the dataset name. Failures are reported with a warning and error details are retained in the per-dataset score table. Use representative datasets; the gap is descriptive, and raw RMSE may be dominated by datasets with larger outcome scales.

References

Hog et al., Towards Reliable Scaling Laws for Tabular Foundation Models, https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24214.

Examples

datasets <- list(airquality = na.omit(airquality), mtcars = mtcars)
datasets$airquality$outcome <- datasets$airquality$Temp
datasets$airquality$Temp <- NULL
datasets$mtcars$outcome <- datasets$mtcars$mpg
datasets$mtcars$mpg <- NULL
lodo_engine_audit(datasets, "outcome", c("lm", "glm"),
  .parsnip_fns = "linear_reg", .seed = 280L
)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 5
#>   held_out_dataset selected_model   selection_loss held_out_loss
#>   <chr>            <chr>                     <dbl>         <dbl>
#> 1 airquality       glm - linear_reg           2.69          7.78
#> 2 mtcars           glm - linear_reg           7.78          2.69
#> # ℹ 1 more variable: generalization_gap <dbl>
